thesis: The episode discusses the evolution of market views from the belief that flows are insignificant to the current recognition that flows can significantly impact prices in the short run while fundamentals remain important over the longer horizon. The conversation also explores the career path of the guest, who transitioned from a technology role at a bank to a quantitative hedge fund and finally to a flow-driven strategy at Janus Henderson, highlighting the shift from trying to build exact replicas of the real world to integrating technology and markets into flow and price pressure.
